title: The Witcher
synopsis: Geralt of Rivia, a mutated monster-hunter for hire, journeys toward his destiny in a turbulent world where people often prove more wicked than beasts.

episodes.title: The End's Beginning
episodes.synopsis: Hostile townsfolk and a cunning mage greet Geralt in the town of Blaviken. Ciri finds her royal world upended when Nilfgaard sets its sights on Cintra.

episodes.title: Four Marks
episodes.synopsis: Bullied and neglected, Yennefer accidentally finds a means of escape. Geralt's hunt for a so-called devil goes to hell. Ciri seeks safety in numbers.

episodes.title: Betrayer Moon
episodes.synopsis: Geralt takes on another Witcher's unfinished business in a kingdom stalked by a ferocious beast. At a brutal cost, Yennefer forges a magical new future.

episodes.title: Of Banquets, Bastards and Burials
episodes.synopsis: Against his better judgment, Geralt accompanies Jaskier to a royal ball. Ciri wanders into an enchanted forest. Yennefer tries to protect her charges.

episodes.title: Bottled Appetites
episodes.synopsis: Heedless of warnings, Yennefer looks for a cure to restore what she's lost. Geralt inadvertently puts Jaskier in peril. The search for Ciri intensifies.

episodes.title: Rare Species
episodes.synopsis: A mysterious man tries to entice Geralt to join a hunt for a rampaging dragon, a quest that attracts a familiar face. Ciri questions who she can trust.

episodes.title: Before a Fall
episodes.synopsis: With the Continent at risk from Nilfgaard's rising power, Yennefer revisits her past, while Geralt reconsiders his obligation to the Law of Surprise.

episodes.title: Much More
episodes.synopsis: A terrifying pack of foes lays Geralt low. Yennefer and her fellow mages prepare to fight back. A shaken Ciri depends on the kindness of a stranger.

episodes.title: A Grain of Truth
episodes.synopsis: Geralt sets off with Ciri on a journey that leads him to an old friend. After the Battle of Sodden, Tissaia shows no mercy in her search for information.

episodes.title: Kaer Morhen
episodes.synopsis: Seeking a safe place for Ciri, Geralt heads for home, but danger lurks everywhere — even Kaer Morhen. Yennefer's dreams could be the key to her freedom.

episodes.title: What Is Lost
episodes.synopsis: Impatient with Geralt's methods, Ciri braves major obstacles to prove her mettle. Scheming and suspicion amongst the Brotherhood make Yennefer a target.

episodes.title: Redanian Intelligence
episodes.synopsis: A guest at Kaer Morhen extends a guiding hand to Ciri — and an invitation to Geralt. On the run in Redania, Yennefer seeks safety below ground.

episodes.title: Turn Your Back
episodes.synopsis: As a powerful mage joins the hunt for Ciri, she cuts a deal with Vesemir over his extraordinary discovery. Geralt explores the mystery of the monoliths.

episodes.title: Dear Friend...
episodes.synopsis: A close friend is lost — and another found — as Geralt helps Ciri learn more about her power. Cahir warns Fringilla to focus on their primary mission.

episodes.title: Voleth Meir
episodes.synopsis: Geralt turns to the bard Jaskier for help, Yennefer realizes just how special Ciri is, and tensions rise on the eve of Emperor Emhyr's visit to Cintra.

episodes.title: Family
episodes.synopsis: Geralt faces off with a demon targeting his nearest and dearest while the most powerful players on the Continent ramp up their pursuit of Ciri.

episodes.title: Shaerrawedd
episodes.synopsis: Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri journey to the far reaches of the Continent in search of a safe haven. King Vizimir puts his charming younger brother to use.

episodes.title: Unbound
episodes.synopsis: A shocking discovery awaits Geralt after he obtains information on Rience. Ciri's sense of justice causes problems. Jaskier performs for a royal fan.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.synopsis: Geralt seeks magical help from a family friend as Ciri and Yennefer clash over plans for the future. Philippa and Dijkstra scheme to get Vizimir in line.

episodes.title: The Invitation
episodes.synopsis: Yennefer pitches a bold idea to the Brotherhood, Geralt strikes a dangerous deal with a ferryman, and Triss digs into the mystery of the missing novices.

episodes.title: The Art of the Illusion
episodes.synopsis: Yennefer and Geralt step out arm in arm and dressed to kill at a lavish ball, but all is not as it seems during a night of revelry and revelations.

episodes.title: Everybody Has a Plan 'til They Get Punched in the Face
episodes.synopsis: Betrayal and bloodshed rock the conclave when the hunt for Ciri comes to a head. As sides are chosen and enemies unmasked, nothing will ever be the same.

episodes.title: Out of the Fire, Into the Frying Pan
episodes.synopsis: Haunted by faces from the past, Ciri endures the ultimate test of survival on a desperate journey under the harshest of conditions.

episodes.title: The Cost of Chaos
episodes.synopsis: After the fateful events at Aretuza, Geralt and Yennefer struggle to pick up the pieces and reunite their family as war comes to the Continent.

episodes.title: What Doesn't Kill You Makes You Stronger
episodes.synopsis: Geralt sets out to save Ciri from the claws of Emhyr, unaware of her true fate. Beset by Vilgefortz, Yennefer attempts to uncover his plan.

episodes.title: Dream of a Wish Fulfilled
episodes.synopsis: Ciri gets a chance to prove herself during a robbery. Geralt gains an unlikely ally, as does Yennefer when she visits Montecalvo to look for sanctuary.

episodes.title: Trial by Ordeal
episodes.synopsis: A witch trial pulls Geralt away from his quest. Ciri taps further into the darkness of her new life. Yennefer brings more recruits to her cause.

episodes.title: A Sermon of Survival
episodes.synopsis: Yennefer's conviction starts to waver. Ciri opens up to Mistle about her true identity. Geralt finds himself at the mercy of Dijkstra.

episodes.title: The Joy of Cooking
episodes.synopsis: Catching their breath before attempting a river crossing, Geralt and his party regale each other with stories and song, revealing a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Twilight of the Wolf
episodes.synopsis: Out of options, Yennefer rallies her novices in a deadly battle against the army of Vilgefortz. A dangerous foe catches Ciri's scent.

episodes.title: What I love I do not carry
episodes.synopsis: A trek through treacherous swamplands confronts Geralt with troubling visions. Emhyr discovers what he must do in order to claim absolute power.

episodes.title: Baptism of Fire
episodes.synopsis: As the Continent sinks deeper into war, Geralt, Yennefer and Ciri each meet their fate on the roads they took to avoid it.
